'''LQ-1010-DNG''' was an [[Imperial Trade and Commerce Authority|Imperial Commerce]] permit, required to legitimately transport [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] [[Executioner droid]]s within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A thorough background check accompanied the permit.
